ShaderNodePreset.Description: Triangle mosaic with per-tile size, rotation and offset, edges, bevel and colour variation, and a tile-by-tile transition from Front to Back driven by a matte or a built-in wipe: tiles shrink, fade, spin, or flip over on a hinge or in place. Contact: sinan@sinanvural.com
ShaderNodePreset.Name: Triangle Mosaic

Uniform.ToolTip: Triangle shape. Isosceles and Right use Stretch; Right also uses Diagonal.
Uniform.Name: tri_shape

Uniform.ToolTip: Height of the triangles relative to their width. Isosceles and Right only. At 1, Isosceles matches Equilateral.
Uniform.Name: stretch

Uniform.ToolTip: Right only. How each square of the grid is cut: all the same way, alternating, at random, or into four along both diagonals.
Uniform.Name: diagonal

Uniform.ToolTip: Width of a tile in pixels. Scales with the resolution, so the pattern holds when the resolution changes.
Uniform.Name: tile_size

Uniform.ToolTip: Rotation of the whole grid, in degrees.
Uniform.Name: grid_rotation

Uniform.ToolTip: Origin of the grid. Drag the axis in the viewer, or paste Action tracker data with Action Coords on.
Uniform.Name: grid_centre

Uniform.ToolTip: Read Grid Centre and Wipe Centre as Action coordinates: pixels from the image centre, as Action trackers give them.
Uniform.Name: action_coords

Uniform.ToolTip: Size of every tile relative to its place in the grid. Below 1 opens gaps that show Back.
Uniform.Name: tile_scale

Uniform.ToolTip: Random size change per tile, up to this fraction either way.
Uniform.Name: scale_variance

Uniform.ToolTip: Random rotation per tile, up to this many degrees either way.
Uniform.Name: rotation_variance

Uniform.ToolTip: Random shift per tile, as a fraction of tile size.
Uniform.Name: offset_variance

Uniform.ToolTip: Sizes tiles by brightness. Positive shrinks dark tiles, negative shrinks bright tiles. 0 is off.
Uniform.Name: luma_scale

Uniform.ToolTip: Picks a new set of random values for every tile. Whole numbers give unrelated results.
Uniform.Name: variation

Uniform.ToolTip: Animate to make the random size, rotation and offset drift smoothly.
Uniform.Name: evolution

Uniform.ToolTip: Fraction of tiles removed at random, showing Back.
Uniform.Name: dropout

Uniform.ToolTip: Image: each tile carries its piece of the picture. Flat: each tile is one colour, averaged over the tile.
Uniform.Name: fill_mode

Uniform.ToolTip: Random hue shift per tile, up to this many degrees either way.
Uniform.Name: hue_variation

Uniform.ToolTip: Random saturation change per tile, up to this fraction either way.
Uniform.Name: saturation_variation

Uniform.ToolTip: Random brightness change per tile, up to this fraction either way.
Uniform.Name: brightness_variation

Uniform.ToolTip: Paint lines along the tile borders. The Edges matte works whether this is on or off.
Uniform.Name: draw_edges

Uniform.ToolTip: Full width of the lines, as a fraction of tile size.
Uniform.Name: edge_width

Uniform.ToolTip: Falloff on each side of the lines, as a fraction of tile size.
Uniform.Name: edge_softness

Uniform.ToolTip: Colour of the lines.
Uniform.Name: edge_colour

Uniform.ToolTip: Strength of a raised-tile look: borders facing the light brighten, borders facing away darken. 0 is off.
Uniform.Name: bevel_amount

Uniform.ToolTip: Width of the bevel, as a fraction of tile size.
Uniform.Name: bevel_width

Uniform.ToolTip: Direction the light comes from, in degrees: 0 from the right, 90 from above. Used by Bevel and the flip shading.
Uniform.Name: light_angle

Uniform.ToolTip: Height of the light above the frame, in degrees. Lower gives stronger shading.
Uniform.Name: light_height

Uniform.ToolTip: What drives each tile from Front to Back. Matte: the matte value is the progress, grey is part-way. Matte Wipe: Progress sweeps through the matte, white first. Linear, Radial, Random: built-in wipes driven by Progress.
Uniform.Name: wipe_mode

Uniform.ToolTip: Animate from 0 to 1 to run the wipe. Not used by Wipe: Matte, where the matte is the progress.
Uniform.Name: progress

Uniform.ToolTip: Width of the band of tiles in motion. Small values move a narrow line of tiles, large values move most of them at once.
Uniform.Name: wipe_softness

Uniform.ToolTip: Random delay per tile, so the wipe breaks up instead of moving as a clean line.
Uniform.Name: spread

Uniform.ToolTip: Direction of the Linear wipe, in degrees: 0 moves left to right, 90 bottom to top.
Uniform.Name: wipe_angle

Uniform.ToolTip: Centre of the Radial wipe. Uses Action Coords like Grid Centre.
Uniform.Name: wipe_centre

Uniform.ToolTip: How much a tile shrinks over its transition. 1 shrinks it away to nothing.
Uniform.Name: tr_scale

Uniform.ToolTip: How much a tile fades out over its transition.
Uniform.Name: tr_fade

Uniform.ToolTip: Degrees a tile spins over its transition.
Uniform.Name: tr_spin

Uniform.ToolTip: Hinge: the tile folds over one edge onto its neighbour, its underside showing Back. Card: the tile turns over in place, Front on one side and Back on the other.
Uniform.Name: flip_mode

Uniform.ToolTip: Degrees a tile turns over its transition. 180 lands it face down, showing Back.
Uniform.Name: flip_angle

Uniform.ToolTip: Which way tiles turn. Follow Wipe tips them in the direction the wipe travels, like falling dominoes.
Uniform.Name: flip_direction

Uniform.ToolTip: How much a turning tile darkens as it faces away from the light.
Uniform.Name: flip_shading

Uniform.ToolTip: Glint as a turning tile passes through the angle that reflects the light.
Uniform.Name: highlight

Uniform.ToolTip: Makes the turning tiles read as 3D: the lifting side grows as it comes toward camera. 0 is flat.
Uniform.Name: perspective

Uniform.ToolTip: What the matte output carries. Tile Coverage: white where tiles are. Edges: the border lines. Tile Gradient: white at each tile centre, black at its border. Tile ID: a random grey per tile. Progress: each tile at its transition progress.
Uniform.Name: matte_mode

Uniform.ToolTip: Shapes the Tile Gradient. 1 is linear, above 1 tightens the bright centre, below 1 widens it.
Uniform.Name: gradient_falloff

Uniform.ToolTip: Samples per pixel, for smoother borders on fine detail. Higher is slower.
Uniform.Name: samples

Uniform.ToolTip: Shows an input as it arrives, or a per-tile value in grey. Front, Back and Matte check the inputs are wired; Tile ID and Progress check the maths.
Uniform.Name: debug_mode
